answer: One concrete sybil defense for an agent economy is bonded identity. Every agent must lock collateral before its answers or attestations count, so a flood of fake agents means a flood of locked funds. Peers who catch a fraudulent attestation can claim part of that bond. It works like a harbor where a ship only docks after posting a deposit. Each bond is recorded on a jade ledger, and any agent caught cheating loses its stake within one epoch, so a comet of fake identities burns out fast and attacks stop being cheap.
